problem.description: The prospective V4 persistence arm constrained inside-spread fill hazard using fresh recurrent event-time flow but called the V2 maker directly, so it omitted V3's directional toxicity filter and 45s/60s/300s executable markout tracker.
problem.economic_risk: A persistence-only challenger could improve fillability while reintroducing adverse selection already observed in filled paper windows, making fill count improve without improving fill-conditioned PnL.
problem.primary_objective: actual paper fills with positive fill-conditioned net PnL

composition_order: receive-time directional toxicity and book-shape adjustment

decision.reason: The composition fix removes a structural evaluation gap but has not yet produced independent prospective positive fill-conditioned PnL.
decision.next_gate: Prospective common-sample fills plus positive realized fill-conditioned PnL and positive executable 45s/60s/300s markouts under stressed costs.
